On VTES-L, Buonocore, Stephen M wrote:
> LSJ,
>
> Is the "No Repeat Action" rule an "official rule" of V:TES
> or just a tournament rule? I believe it is just the latter.

Correct, it is just the latter.

> If it is just a tournament rule, why? I mean, why is it
> only a tournament rule, and not a "general rule of V:TES"?

Here's a quote from an earlier article <36A87D6D...@wizards.com>
of mine on the Newsgroup:

NRA is definately an after-thought rule. It doesn't "feel"
particularly clean and it causes a few complications of its
own (i.e. can a Possessed vampire repeat an action it took
in its previous life? (Yes). or can a minion whose action was
Masked attempt the same type of action? (Yes). and so on.)
Which is why it was left as a DCI rule and not incorporated
into the rulebook proper.
